## Executive Summary  
FirstUK Bank operates 12 branches across the United Kingdom, strategically located to serve customer bases in major metropolitan areas and regional centers. Branches provide full banking services including account opening, customer service, and cash handling.  
**Total Branches:** 12
**Total Branch Staff:** 12 (1–2 per branch)
**Head Office:** London
**Service Hours:** Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00, Saturday 09:00–13:00

## Branch Operations  
### Daily Operations  
**Opening Checklist:**
- Cash vault verification
- ATM stocking and balance
- System connectivity test
- Security alarm test
- Staff briefing  
**See:** Daily Operations Checklist (DOC-001)  
**Closing Checklist:**
- Cash reconciliation
- ATM cash count
- System shutdown
- Security alarm activation
- End-of-day report
header_path: FirstUK Bank — Branch Network > Branch Operations > Daily Operations

name: Chunk 16/34
text:
### Cash Handling  
**Policy:** Cash Handling Procedures (CHP-001)  
- **Daily Cash Limit:** £20,000 per branch
- **Vault Security:** Dual custody (manager + officer)
- **Reconciliation:** Daily EOD
- **Dispute Resolution:** <£1,000 threshold for branch manager approval  
**Armored Transport:** Provided by external contractor (Brinks)
**Collection Schedule:** 3x weekly (Mon, Wed, Fri)
header_path: FirstUK Bank — Branch Network > Branch Operations > Cash Handling

name: Chunk 17/34
text:
### Security  
**Branch Security Measures:**
- CCTV (24/7 recording, 30-day retention)
- Alarm system (monitored by external provider)
- Safe/vault (dual custody)
- Employee ID badges
- Customer ID verification for account access  
**See:** Branch Security Policy (SEC-POL-001)
